notes.title: COOP Update | Phase #1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41854789/fa1b57b493efffbeca91a51916f695ad3f943a0c.png[/img]

[h1]Greetings, my ribbeting comrades![/h1]

[h2]Prepare yourselves for the epicness of Phase #1 in the coop mode![/h2]

BUT!! Hold on to your lilypad hats, because there are a few limitations we must address! :( Let's take a gander at 'em, shall we?
[list]
[*] The server can only handle 20 players at the same time (it's like a crowded pond party!)
[*] Oopsie-daisy! We forgot to include the reconnect feature (coming soon, hopefully not as soon as a frog's tongue!)
[*] We're currently missing the in-game invite acceptation (but we promise it's hopping your way)
[*] The bots are a tad bit passive, and you can't adjust the difficulty level (they need some froggy courage!)
[/list]

Fear not, for I, your dedicated froggy friend, am diligently working on resolving this list and will hop to it as soon as possible! In the meantime, in case you haven't caught wind of it yet, the fabulous Canadian streamer [url=https://www.twitch.tv/super_cubby]Super_Cubby[/url] has graciously blessed us with a frog-tastic song for our beloved Krek Da Frog. Ribbiting, isn't it?
[previewyoutube=0rK0fjEWX5M;full][/previewyoutube]

Guess what? Super_Cubby has agreed to be the first official streamer to join me in a cooperative gameplay extravaganza! Keep an eye out for updates, or if you're feeling extra froggy, you can hop on over to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bl0ckdave]my Twitch channel[/url] and give it a follow.

Stay tuned, my froggy friends!
Bl0ckDave

notes.title: Krek Da Frog Reborn Patch
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41854789/00e37ea25ecc831a8e8d23e26d17e9c7bcbbb2bf.png[/img]
After long time, I came back to this challenge project and decided to make „some“ changes.
So here is list of changes:

New Features:
•	Butterflies are less passive, if player is near for longer time, butterfly will fly out for a while.
•	New destinations  - Pandia, Ersa, Eirene, Philophrosyne and Eupheme 
•	Level „Magic doors“  are for teleporting to the next level

Fixes:
•	Player movement
•	Material smoothness and metalic values


Changes:
•	New game logic, player have to eat enough butterflies to open doors which transport player to the next level.
•	Player now can visit buildings and previously non reachable areas
•	Red butterfly is not toxic anymore
•	Environment water is toxic or too salt for frogs, anytimes player fell to the water looses his life

TODO:
•	Animations are less acurate right now 
•	SFX issues
•	End of season aiming issues


[h2]New destinations[/h2]

[h3]Pandia[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41854789/2a90b2f2c53d79b2127006d88635610f00011ebb.png[/img]

First and easiest level, on this island is more butterflies than is required, all you need is to eat 5 blue butterflies, 5 red butterflies, 5 yellow butterflies and find where are doors. Doors position is not a secret, but to get there you will have to get over broken bridge.

Last known Door position:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41854789/6dfdebe8042d91db70a1f1e5f154fda5b791bc8e.png[/img]

[h3]Ersa[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41854789/bba38b3be3a8be7458a49078b00b1cd230d4029e.png[/img]

Second level is easy too but there are exact butterflies count as is required to get to next level , player must eat 10 blue, 10 yellow, 10 red butterflies and reach doors. Player also must get over toxic water by walking on planks or bridges between small islands.

Last known Door position:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41854789/5fd718a48fd46d05c713efeaeb3da6fffd638337.png[/img]
 
[h3]Eirene[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41854789/a0f4b875d2d09dfdae6386599c18ce1f476dbe05.png[/img]

Third level is very dark, there are exact butterflies count as is required to get to next level , player must eat 20 blue, 15 yellow, 15 red butterflies and reach doors. Player also must get over toxic water by walking on planks between big and inner island.

Last known Door position:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41854789/b67da9f05c5ca30bcb30990db4b671a1371ba6dc.png[/img]

[h3]Philophrosyne[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41854789/0cd818c66f9daccaafef70ef8c0f3c9a76f66b9f.png[/img]

Fourth level is the biggest single island in this scene, there are exact butterflies count as is required to get to next level , player must eat 20 blue, 20 yellow, 20 red butterflies and reach doors. Player also must climb to the highest point of the island to reach doors.

Last known Door position:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41854789/0550a2a65f3040ea4a232ff7d6644968b21dde54.png[/img]

[h3]Eupheme[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41854789/cc75b665018707d265eefe58175889bb458d88e7.png[/img]

Fifth level is the last one in this season, there are also exact butterflies count as is required to get to next level , player must eat 30 blue, 20 yellow, 25 red butterflies and reach doors. Player also must get over toxic water by using moving stones to reach all islands and later doors.

Last known Door position:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41854789/724fd270d5f35aa359fb67beb7cd32984fe4c96a.png[/img]

[h2]Map overview[/h2]

To get to the single level you have to use new menu which is season overviewer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41854789/677267fa116dac3be7fa601670b707f00e25f2e6.png[/img]


There are still lot work to do so you can expect another updates soon.
Your Bl0ckDave!
